title: Tandem Assault
text: Attack with a space unit. If you do, attack with a ground unit, and that ground unit gets +2/+0 for this attack.
rules:
If you play Tandem Assault, you must attack with a space unit, if able. If you do, you must attack with a ground unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
Fully resolve the first attack, including all triggers, before beginning the second attack.
